preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.
The number of friends is less than the number of rooms, and the sum of n over all test cases is not greater than 2*10^5.
The rooms with friends are between 2 and n, inclusive.
The rooms connected by corridors are between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: x_i != x_j for all i != j
preconditions.description: No two friends are in the same room.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a string.
The output for each test case is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: Vlad can win in any way friends play
postconditions.description: Vlad can guarantee a victory if he can reach a room other than 1 into which exactly one corridor leads.

invariants.description: The room system forms an undirected tree.
